card.name: Community event announcements and listings
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words inside announcements for public festivals and fairs, such as the time range dash, 'There will be', 'visitors can also enjoy', and 'Free admission'. It fires where the text is about to describe what is happening at the event.

modes.label: Time range dash
modes.description: The dash between start and end times in an event listing with location and time.

modes.description: Small words in sentences saying what visitors will find or do at the event.
